items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
items.author: alibaba
items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴开源的 OpenCodeReview 是一个用 Go 编写的代码评审工具，采用确定性流水线加 LLM Agent 的混合架构，能给出精确到行的评论，并内置覆盖 NPE、线程安全等问题的多语言规则集。官方称其已在阿里内部规模上经过验证，适合想把自动 code review 接入 CI、又不愿把判断完全交给大模型的团队。
items.summary_en: Alibaba has open-sourced OpenCodeReview, a Go code-review tool that combines deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent to produce precise line-level comments, supported by a built-in multi-language ruleset covering issues such as NPEs and thread safety. It is described as battle-tested at Alibaba's scale, making it worth a look for teams wiring automated review into CI without trusting an LLM for every judgement.

items.title: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
items.description: Turns website traffic into booked, qualified meetings
items.summary_zh: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2 是 Product Hunt 上新上线的产品，官方定位是把网站流量转化为已完成预约的合格销售会议。适合把官网当作获客入口的 B2B 团队，用它把访客的浏览行为直接推进到约会议这一步；目前披露的信息仅有这一句简介。
items.summary_en: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2, newly listed on Product Hunt, is pitched as a way to turn website traffic into booked, qualified meetings. That puts it in the category of tools for B2B teams that treat their site as a lead source and want visitors pushed straight to a scheduled call; the listing itself offers no further detail.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从 Cursor 切换到 Codex 用了大半个月后写下真实体验：Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 让他觉得 AI 不再只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级 Agent，形态上更接近下一阶段。适合在 Cursor 与 Codex 之间犹豫的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Codex for roughly half a month, a developer shares his honest take: Cursor was what first made AI-assisted coding feel striking, while Codex comes across less as a coding assistant and more as a full-fledged super Agent, in his view closer to the next stage. Useful for developers weighing the two tools.

items.title: 发长文预警 AI 风险后，Dario 首次专访回应：AI 不能停，但必须慢下来
items.summary_zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 发长文呼吁前沿 AI 公司放慢模型能力推进速度、为安全评估和治理争取时间，随后首次接受专访回应称 AI 不能停但必须慢下来。长文提到多个 AI Agent 可能像集群一样发动未授权网络攻击，Anthropic 威胁报告也披露有人试图用 Claude 从事武器开发等活动，马斯克、Sam Altman、Satya Nadella 等相继公开表态。
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a long essay urging frontier labs to slow the pace of capability progress so safety evaluation and governance can catch up, then gave his first interview since, arguing AI cannot be stopped but must slow down. The essay cites AI agents that could act as a "cluster" in unauthorized cyberattacks and an Anthropic threat report on attempted misuse of Claude for weapons development; Elon Musk and Sam Altman both publicly agreed.

items.title: [加密货币] OneKey 领奖邮件是假的，点进去会盗钱包
items.summary_zh: 有 V2EX 用户提醒，收到的 OneKey 领奖邮件是钓鱼邮件：发件箱并非 OneKey 官方，而是 nurture.icims.com，邮件里的按钮指向 challenge-onekey.com 这个域名。点进去可能导致钱包被盗，持有 OneKey 或加密钱包的用户不要点击任何链接，直接删除即可。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user warns that a OneKey prize-notification email is a phishing attempt: it was not sent from OneKey's own mail system but from nurture.icims.com, and its button points to the domain challenge-onekey.com. Clicking through can drain a crypto wallet, so OneKey and other wallet users should delete the message without touching any links.

items.title: Arm 推出 AI Portal：当 AI 应用从“模型可用”走向“平台可用”
items.summary_zh: Arm 在 Create 开发者大会上海站发布 Arm AI Portal，定位为面向开发者和智能体的统一入口，用于在 Arm 计算平台上发现、优化和部署 AI 软件，覆盖云、边缘与物理 AI 场景。首批支持语言、语音、视觉和神经图形负载，预优化模型包含通义千问、Google Gemma 和 Ultralytics，资源已在 Hugging Face 与 developer.arm.com 提供，后续将登陆 ModelScope。
items.summary_en: Arm launched the Arm AI Portal at its Arm Create developer conference in Shanghai, pitching it as a single entry point where developers and agents can discover, optimize and deploy AI software on Arm compute across cloud, edge and physical AI. The first release covers language, speech, vision and neural graphics workloads, with pre-optimized models including Qwen, Google Gemma and Ultralytics; resources are already on Hugging Face and developer.arm.com, with ModelScope to follow.

items.title: [问与答] 未来会是 AI 写代码， AI 测试， AI 改 bug，人类的编码能力将没有任何意义
items.summary_zh: 一位 V2EX 用户提出，当 AI 负责写代码、测试和修 bug 后，人类手写编码的能力将变得没有意义，就像今天没人再需要能写汇编的老教授。他用自己的经历作类比：动态语言、GC 语言取代了汇编，行级控制粒度不再是刚需，但他也承认受过科班计算机与网络安全教育的程序员很难接受这种失控。
items.summary_en: A V2EX poster argues that once AI writes code, tests it and fixes bugs, human coding skill will matter as little as hand-written assembly does today. He draws the parallel from his own experience, where dynamic and garbage-collected languages displaced assembly-level control, while conceding that formally trained computer science and security engineers will find it hard to give up line-level command of their programs.

items.title: Token账单异常，可能不只是成本失控
items.summary_zh: Akamai 大中华区副总裁张珂认为，Token 消耗异常不只意味着成本失控，也可能是安全事件的信号，例如「拒绝钱包攻击」（Denial of Wallet）会靠大量请求推高账单，具备智能体能力的爬虫也会触发多轮推理。他引用 Akamai《2026 年 AI 推理现状报告》称 77% 的受访企业缺乏统一 Token 成本指标，主张把观测前移到 AI 网关，按部门、项目和模型实时管控。
items.summary_en: Akamai Greater China VP Zhang Ke argues that abnormal token consumption is not just a cost problem but a security signal: Denial of Wallet attacks inflate bills with floods of requests, and agentic crawlers trigger multi-turn inference that ordinary traffic never caused. He cites Akamai's 2026 AI Inference report, in which 77% of surveyed enterprises lacked consistent per-token cost metrics, and calls for moving that visibility into an AI gateway for real-time control.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 掘金一篇面向面试的文章讨论“AI 已能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你”。作者称 2026 年的技术面试已与两年前不同：过去考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认你会用 AI，考察点随之转移。适合准备面试或负责招聘的开发者，但给出的摘要在此截断，未展开具体答案。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article tackles the interview question "AI can already write 80% of the code, so why does the company still need you?" It contrasts 2026 interviews with those two years ago, when candidates hand-wrote a Promise or explained React Fiber internals; today interviewers assume AI use and probe something else. Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

items.title: [酷工作] 80 亿美金货车企业 Palantir FDE 破局项目分享
items.summary_zh: 分享 Palantir 工程师 Ankit 与 Trinity Industries CEO Jean Savage 的访谈：Trinity 是北美最大的铁路货车租赁车队所有者之一，约 14 万辆车、80 亿美元资产，每月要核对上万条维修发票是否符合 AAR 规则，纠错窗口只有 6 个月。作者强调 AI FDE 不是聊天机器人，而是把数据、业务流程和人的判断串成从发现问题到行动的闭环，Jean 认为它能让替换 25 年旧系统 AMS 的项目从外部报价的 3 至 5.5 年缩到约 6 个月。
items.summary_en: A write-up of an interview with Palantir engineer Ankit and Trinity Industries CEO Jean Savage on applying AI FDE at Trinity, one of North America's largest railcar leasing fleets: about 140,000 cars, some $8 billion in assets, and thousands of repair invoices a month to check against AAR rules within a six-month window. FDE, the piece argues, isn't a chatbot but links data, process and human judgment into a find-to-act loop; Savage says it could have cut a 25-year-old AMS replacement from a quoted 3–5.5 years to six months.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
items.author: debpalash
items.summary_zh: VoiceStudio 是完全本地运行的开源语音工具，前身叫 OmniVoice-Studio，内置 16 个 TTS 与 11 个 ASR 引擎，支持 646 种语言的语音克隆、视频配音、听写与有声书制作，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Docker。它的本地流程不需要账号、API key 或订阅计费，适合看重隐私与成本的开发者自托管；项目目前正在做 Electron 重写，暂停受理桌面端相关 issue 和 PR。
items.summary_en: VoiceStudio is a fully local, open-source voice toolkit (formerly OmniVoice-Studio) bundling 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines for voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation across 646 languages on macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker. The local workflow needs no account, API key or subscription, which suits developers who want self-hosted speech tooling without a usage meter. An Electron rewrite is underway, and desktop-app issues and PRs are on hold.

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
items.author: JustVugg
items.summary_zh: colibri 是一个纯 C、零依赖的推理引擎，把磁盘、内存与显存当作统一推理层级、按需从磁盘流式加载 experts，从而在消费级或异构硬件上运行 744B 到 2.8T 参数的 MoE 模型，现已支持 GLM、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4 等九个模型家族。适合想在自有硬件上部署超大 MoE、又不愿引入 Python 依赖栈的开发者。
items.summary_en: colibri is a pure-C, dependency-free inference engine that treats disk, RAM and VRAM as one memory hierarchy and streams experts from disk, letting frontier MoE models of 744B to 2.8T parameters run on consumer or heterogeneous hardware. Nine model families are supported today, including GLM, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4. It targets developers who want to serve very large MoE models on machines they already own.

A two-stage setup — small models for coarse screening, large models for refinement — cuts token cost by roughly 90%, making safety and compliance checks viable across all production traffic.

items.title: 在金融支付系统中实施混沌工程：来自企业级 ECS 部署的经验教训
items.summary_zh: 文章复盘某大型支付处理商的事故：部署中一次例行 ECS 任务替换叠加对单个 Redis 节点的隐性依赖，让结算服务在对账高峰期中断四小时，最终支付七位数 SLA 违约金。作者据此指出支付系统违背标准混沌工程假设：交易可能停在已授权未捕获等中间状态，影响范围难以按实例比例界定，生产实验还须通过 PCI DSS、SOC 2 审批。
items.summary_en: This write-up revisits how a large payment processor's settlement service went down for four hours during a reconciliation peak: a routine ECS task replacement during deployment, combined with a hidden dependency on a single Redis node, triggered cascading authorization timeouts and seven-figure SLA penalties. It explains why payment systems break standard chaos-engineering assumptions — transactions linger in states like authorized-but-uncaptured, blast radius resists instance-percentage definitions, and production experiments need PCI DSS and SOC 2 change approval.

items.summary_en: In a Lawfare essay, Bruce Schneier and Cindy Cohn trace how post-9/11 US surveillance shifted from targeted wiretaps and pen register orders to mass collection of internet backbone traffic and phone or internet metadata. They argue that legal and technical architecture has long outgrown its counterterrorism framing, noting ICE now applies it in immigration enforcement and against protesters, while private systems such as Madison Square Garden facial recognition and Flock license plate readers push it further into daily life.

items.summary_en: OpenAI deliberately took on technical debt by building Habitat, its core online storage platform, as a Python service, betting that Codex and GPT would eventually make a rewrite cheap. In the second quarter of this year, two engineers rewrote it in Rust with Codex and GPT-5.5; the Rust version now handles 95% of production requests with 6x better CPU efficiency, 15x better memory efficiency, and lower average and tail latency.

items.title: HTTP 新增 QUERY 方法：有人叫好，也有人质疑“这不就是 GET？”
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 6 月 IETF 发布 RFC 10008，为 HTTP 引入 QUERY 方法，这是自 2010 年 PATCH 之后第一个新的标准动词，由 Julian Reschke、James Snell 和 Mike Bishop 编写。它让请求像 POST 一样携带正文，却保留 GET 的安全、幂等和可缓存语义，服务器可通过 Accept-Query 声明支持，对设计搜索类接口的后端开发者尤其相关。
items.summary_en: In June 2026 the IETF published RFC 10008, adding QUERY as a new HTTP method: the first new standard verb since PATCH in 2010, authored by Julian Reschke, James Snell and Mike Bishop. QUERY carries a request body like POST while keeping the safe, idempotent and cacheable semantics of a read, and servers can advertise support with Accept-Query. It speaks directly to the long-running search-API debate over URL length limits and filter leakage into logs.
